responsibility: Implements an SH-specific RTL optimization pass for combining T-register based comparisons, cstores, and conditional branches across basic blocks. It traces how branch-test temporaries were produced from prior T-bit results, then rewrites control-flow regions to eliminate redundant zero-comparisons or T-bit stores, factor common comparisons into the branch block, invert conditions when legal, and optionally split newly formed insns after the transformation.
